bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for improvements to the Conway Recreation Center in the city of St. Paul; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+ST. PAUL; CONWAY RECREATION CENTER. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriations.+]

[+$3,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Sanneh Foundation, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to design, construct, furnish, and equip improvements necessary for renovation and expansion of the Conway Recreation Center in the city of St. Paul. The expanded and renovated facility will provide a permanent food distribution center, senior center, health and wellness clinic, and women's athletic center for community gathering, health care service delivery, and nutritional outreach. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Bond sale.+]

[+To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $3,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to capital investment; appropriating money for improvements to the Conway Recreation Center in the city of St. Paul; authorizing the sale and issuance of state bonds.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. ST. PAUL; CONWAY RECREATION CENTER.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriations.

$3,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Sanneh Foundation, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to design, construct, furnish, and equip improvements necessary for renovation and expansion of the Conway Recreation Center in the city of St. Paul. The expanded and renovated facility will provide a permanent food distribution center, senior center, health and wellness clinic, and women's athletic center for community gathering, health care service delivery, and nutritional outreach.

Subd. 2.

Bond sale.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $3,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: $3,000,000 is appropriated from the bond proceeds fund to the commissioner of employment and economic development for a grant to the Sanneh Foundation, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, to design, construct, furnish, and equip improvements necessary for renovation and expansion of the Conway Recreation Center in the city of St. Paul. The expanded and renovated facility will provide a permanent food distribution center, senior center, health and wellness clinic, and women's athletic center for community gathering, health care service delivery, and nutritional outreach.

To provide the money appropriated in this section from the bond proceeds fund, the commissioner of management and budget shall sell and issue bonds of the state in an amount up to $3,000,000 in the manner, upon the terms, and with the effect prescribed by Minnesota Statutes, sections 16A.631 to 16A.675, and by the Minnesota Constitution, article XI, sections 4 to 7.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
